copy.tagline_en: Integrate WhatsApp Cloud API into your app

howto.what: Claude 会为 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 官方 Cloud API 通道：复制并注册 whatsapp-cloud 适配器，安装固定版本依赖，构建并测试，使机器人能用官方 Meta API 收发一对一 WhatsApp 消息。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp 官方 Cloud API 通道时触发，例如说“添加 WhatsApp 通道”“接入 WhatsApp Cloud API”。流程会要求你提供 Meta 开发者平台的访问令牌等凭据。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接上 WhatsApp Cloud API
say.note: 会开始复制适配器并注册通道。

say.text: 添加 WhatsApp 官方通道，用 Meta 的 API
say.note: 会安装依赖并跑测试验证。

say.text: 给机器人配置 WhatsApp Business Cloud 通道
say.note: 会提示你粘贴 Meta 凭据。

howto.what_en: Claude will add the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel to NanoClaw: it copies and registers the whatsapp-cloud adapter, installs a pinned dependency, builds and tests, letting the bot send and receive 1:1 WhatsApp messages via the official Meta API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect NanoClaw to the official WhatsApp Cloud API, e.g. 'add WhatsApp channel' or 'integrate WhatsApp Cloud API'. The process asks for Meta developer credentials like an access token.

say_en.text: Set up NanoClaw with the WhatsApp Cloud API
say_en.note: It starts copying the adapter and registering the channel.

say_en.text: Add the official WhatsApp channel via Meta's API
say_en.note: It installs the dependency and runs tests.

say_en.text: Configure the WhatsApp Business Cloud channel for the bot
say_en.note: It prompts you to paste Meta credentials.
